# Glossary
The glossary section helps users understand Aadhaar-related terminology, authentication concepts, ecosystem entities, technical processes, and commonly used definitions in a simple and accessible manner. Find information on Aadhaar services, AUAs, ASAs, authentication devices, APIs, seeding, verification and other key terms used across the Aadhaar ecosystem.
